etsy.title: Left 4 Over Crest Rally Car Poster, Pace Notes Wall Art, Rally Driver Gift, Garage Race Decor
etsy.description:
A rally car poster that prints one pace-note call in bold stencil type: LEFT 4, OVER CREST, DON'T CUT, with a road arrow.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang it in a garage, man cave, home office, or on a rally fan's wall.

An original design with no team, series, or manufacturer marks.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Crest and jump rally prints on Etsy almost all show a named real car mid-air; none use the pace-note call itself as the artwork.
A pace-note t-shirt uses lines such as 'flat over crest', which confirms the call is recognised by fans, but no poster version surfaced.
Physical rally jump prints in the results were about $18 to $20 USD; jump-themed clipart bundles are digital and much cheaper.
Amazon rally wall art is photo or painting style, sold as canvas sets or unframed prints by size, pitched at car enthusiasts for offices and garages.

research.notes: Keyword phrases from research/keywords/rally.json (search-results, 2026-11-01). This is the only one of my five rally posters that leads with 'rally car poster' (the strongest indexed phrase); 'over crest' from the design keeps it distinct. 'left 4 over crest' is the printed text, not an evidenced search phrase. 'stage rally poster' is a seen phrase, not confirmed indexed. The price range comes from two crest/jump print snippets, not from pages.
